frame: Module frame: origin at the outline centre; +x along the header row from pin 1 to the last pin (two-row modules: along the rows, pin 1 end at -x); +y from the header toward the module body (two-row modules: from the first-listed row to the second). Millimetres. 'front' is the face away from the carrier board.

headers.name: GND VCC SCL SDA RES DC CS BLK

features.name: active area 240x240
features.note: cut the window over the active area plus about 0.5 mm, not over the module outline

sources: BLOCK.md: module 32 x 43.7 mm, stands off the board, the header is the only fixation
assumptions: header row 2.5 mm from the module edge
active area centred on the module
mounting hole positions are typical, measure before relying on them
